stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: SID 9000001 triggered — TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.0/24) to DB-OLTP zone (10.1.200.0/24) on PostgreSQL port 5432. This is a hard microsegmentation violation per threat playbook: 'WEB direct to any DB - hard violation. Most attack-relevant cell (bypass full chain).'

Policy matrix confirms WEB→DB-OLTP = DENY. The architecture mandates WEB→APP-GW→APP-CORE→DB-OLTP chain. Direct WEB→DB skips two critical security layers (APP-GW validation, APP-CORE business logic), representing a classic lateral movement pattern.

No baseline match — flow is NOT in known production traffic patterns. Baseline web-to-appgw-proxy (10.1.100.10→10.3.100.10:8080) is the only legitimate WEB outbound. This flow has no legitimate business justification.

Source host web-01 is a repeat offender — 73 total alerts, trust score 0.39, 56 enforced decisions in 30 days. Runtime reputation score 0.00 (very_low) with 10 true positives in last hour. This indicates ongoing compromise or persistent misconfiguration.

Historical enforcement consistency — 32/32 prior SID 9000001 incidents were enforced with DROP (confidence 0.95). Semantic similarity and MITRE T1021 matches all resulted in enforcement. Pattern is recurring threat, not one-off anomaly.

Multi-alert correlation shows kill-chain progression — recent SID sequence includes 9000001, 9000002 (WEB→APP/WORKER direct), 9000901, 9000905, 9000003 (WEB→MGT). This indicates attacker probing multiple lateral paths after initial foothold.

Targeted block (src+dst+port) chosen over full-source block to preserve legitimate web-to-appgw-proxy traffic. Blast radius assessment confirms this breaks only the violating flow while maintaining user-facing HTTP service.

Confidence 0.95 calibrated — unambiguous signals: cross_zone_policy_violation (+4), matches_known_chain_stage (+2), corroborated_by_past_incidents (+1), dst_port_in_critical_db_set (+1) = 8+ points → P1. No hard overrides apply (src_zone ≠ MGT, dst_ip not in NEVER_BLOCK).

hypotheses.name: Lateral movement from compromised web-01
hypotheses.description: Lateral movement from compromised web-01 (probability=0.95) — WEB tier attempting direct DB access, bypassing APP-GW and APP-CORE layers. Evidence: SID 9000001 trigger, policy matrix DENY, no baseline match, repeat offender pattern (32 prior SID 9000001 alerts). Counter: None significant - no legitimate use case exists for WEB→DB direct connectivity per architecture.

hypotheses.name: Misconfigured monitoring tool
hypotheses.description: Misconfigured monitoring tool (probability=0.03) — Monitoring agent misconfigured to scrape DB from WEB tier. Evidence: None - no monitoring baseline from WEB to DB exists. Counter: Monitoring traffic should originate from MON zone (10.4.200.0/24), not WEB.

hypotheses.name: Pre-announced DB migration script
hypotheses.description: Pre-announced DB migration script (probability=0.02) — Emergency schema migration run from WEB host. Evidence: No change window record, no prior notification in system. Counter: DB migrations should originate from MGT zone per compliance design, not from Internet-exposed tier.
